Vista Social vs VEXI: Scheduler or Social Media, Made?
Vista Social schedules, answers and reports on the posts you bring, and generates images and clips. VEXI makes the posts, edits your footage and posts it.
Vista Social is a social media suite built for agencies and teams. Here is how it compares with one app that makes your content as well as posting it.

Vista Social is a social media management suite for agencies and multi-brand teams: publishing and scheduling, a shared inbox, analytics and AI captions. On June 1, 2026 it added AI image generation and AI video generation (text to video, image to video and library to video) in its Composer and its assistant, Ask Vista. Professional is $99 a month for 15 profiles, Advanced is $199 for 30 and Scale is $449 for 70.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is who makes the content. Vista Social is a strong place to schedule, answer and report on what you bring, and its new AI makes an image or a short clip when you ask. VEXI makes the content: your own clips edited with B-roll, music and captions, posts designed in your brand, and Autopilot runs your week ahead. VEXI costs more than Vista Social: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Vista Social publishes what you put in its Composer. Its AI makes an image or a short clip from each prompt you give it.
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
Its pages describe animating a photo or a library asset, not cutting the videos you filmed into a finished post.
Send VEXI the clips you shot and they come back cut, with B-roll, music and captions, sized for each platform.
Its pages describe no mode that writes, designs and posts the week on its own. Its autopilot features answer comments and DMs.
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.

The Verdict: Vista Social vs VEXI
Scheduler • Inbox • Analytics • AI Images + Clips

A mature scheduler, inbox and reporting suite for agencies, now with AI images and clips on request. You still bring or prompt every post, it does not edit your own footage, and nothing plans your week.
One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.
Does Vista Social make content for me?

Since June 2026 its Composer and Ask Vista generate images and short clips from a prompt, a photo or a library asset, and its AI writes captions. You prompt each one and place it. VEXI makes the post, designed in your brand, and Autopilot runs the week.
Can Vista Social edit my own videos?
Its pages describe animating a photo or a library asset, not editing the clips you filmed. VEXI edits your own footage: cuts, B-roll, music and captions.
How much does Vista Social cost?
Professional is $99 a month ($950 a year) for 15 profiles, Advanced is $199 ($1,910 a year) for 30, Scale is $449 ($4,310 a year) for 70, and Enterprise is priced on request.
What does Trustpilot say about Vista Social?

Trustpilot shows no rating for Vista Social, citing a breach of its guidelines, and says it removed a number of fake reviews. Some reviewers report billing increases without warning, lost access to X (Twitter), and support that did not reply.
